root_cause: The generic production route verifier proved the route healthy, yet the pricing-specific verifier intermittently timed out during its initial body/runtime-ready bootstrap before testing any control. It used one page and one readiness attempt, so transient CDN/browser readiness races blocked terminal proof.
prevention_rule: The pricing production verifier retries only TimeoutError during its initial page/body/runtime-ready bootstrap, using a fresh page per attempt, maximum three attempts with bounded backoff. All product interaction assertions remain unchanged and non-timeout failures remain terminal.
failed_approaches: Retrying the entire failed workflow confirmed the failure class moved between bootstrap and actionability, proving a single unbounded attempt was too fragile.
Verifier-only stable scrolling fixed the later scroll actionability race but could not address a prior body/runtime bootstrap timeout.

invariants: force click and DOM click bypass remain forbidden

terminal_rule: LIVE_BEWEZEN only after protected merge and exact-production pricing lifecycle, billing and English-route browser proof.
